headline: Shadowfax Acquires WeFast for 23 Crore Rupees to Expand Intra-City Logistics
summary: Logistics platform Shadowfax acquired WeFast for 23 crore rupees to expand into India's intra-city delivery market, which is valued at $15 billion.
why: Shadowfax is a tech-enabled third-party logistics firm operating across India.
